question: (sqrt{(46+38)² - 4 times 46 times 38}) = ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use the algebraic identity: (a + b)² − 4ab = (a − b)²

Here, a = 46 and b = 38.

The expression becomes √((46 − 38)²) = 46 − 38.

Value = 8.

**∴ The correct answer is 8.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: √((46 + 38)² − 4 × 46 × 38)

Formula used: (a + b)² − 4ab = (a − b)²

⇒ √((84)² − 4 × 1748)

⇒ √(7056 − 6992)

⇒ √64

⇒ 8

**∴ The correct answer is 8.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Square of Difference Identity

The formula (a − b)² = a² − 2ab + b² is used to calculate the square of the subtraction of two numbers.

Algebraic Relation

(a + b)² − (a − b)² = 4ab is an identity relating the sum, the difference, and the product of two variables.

Square of Sum Identity

The formula (a + b)² = a² + 2ab + b² represents the expansion of the square of a binomial sum.
